item.title: Lathes for Automation Machinery and Machine Builders | KINWA
item.description:
Automation Machinery
#

KINWA lists automation machinery as a main application area. Automation equipment, machine tools, production cells and special-purpose machines require a wide range of turned parts: shafts, rollers, pins, bushings, spacers, fittings, sensor housings and custom connectors.

item.title: Lathes for Automotive and Motorcycle Parts | KINWA
item.description:
Automotive and Motorcycle Parts
#

Automotive and motorcycle manufacturing requires large numbers of rotationally symmetric parts with consistent dimensions and surface finish. KINWA lists automobile and motorcycle parts as a main application for its lathes, and its company profile also covers automotive and transportation components.

item.title: KINWA Blog: Lathe Buying, Stability and Machining Insights
item.description:
KINWA Blog
#

KINWA’s English blog focuses on practical lathe selection and machining stability. The three current articles examine purchase decisions from a long-term cost perspective, explain chatter through machine dynamics, and compare manual and CNC lathes for machine shops.

item.title: CH Series High Speed Precision Engine Lathe | KINWA
item.description:
CH Series: High Speed Precision Engine Lathe
#

The CH Series is KINWA’s general-purpose high-speed precision engine lathe line. It is designed for stable manual turning, easy operation and long-term reliability in workshops, maintenance departments, tool rooms, mold shops, technical schools and high-mix low-volume production.

item.title: CHD Series Heavy Duty Precision Lathe | KINWA
item.description:
CHD Series: Heavy Duty Precision Lathe
#

The CHD Series extends KINWA’s manual lathe range to larger workpieces and heavier cutting. It is positioned between the general-purpose CH Series and the large CHK Series, making it suitable for job shops and manufacturers that need more swing and spindle capacity without moving to a very large machine.

item.title: CHK Series Heavy Duty Precision Lathe | KINWA Large Lathe
item.description:
CHK Series: Large Heavy Duty Precision Lathe
#

The CHK Series is KINWA’s largest manual lathe family. It is designed for large-diameter workpieces, long shafts and heavy components where rigidity and spindle capacity are critical. Typical work includes rollers, shafts, sleeves, flanges, pipe fittings and components for energy, heavy machinery and transportation equipment.

item.title: CL Series Flat Bed CNC Lathe | KINWA
item.description:
CL Series - Flat Bed: Large Bore and Long Bed Capacity
#

The CL Series flat-bed CNC lathes are KINWA’s answer to large workpieces, long shafts and jobs that require a big spindle bore. The range starts with the CL-650 and extends to the CL-38, CL-58, CL-68 and CL-78, with swing over bed from 660 mm to 1,500 mm and between-centers lengths up to 6,430 mm.

item.title: CL Series Gang Type CNC Lathe | KINWA
item.description:
CL Series - Gang Type: Compact CNC Turning
#

The CL Series gang-type CNC lathes are KINWA’s compact solution for small workpieces, bar work and high-volume production. Instead of a turret, the tools are mounted on a gang bed fixed to the cross slide. This arrangement shortens tool-change travel, reduces cycle time and keeps the machine footprint small.

item.title: CL Series Slant Bed CNC Lathe | KINWA
item.description:
CL Series - Slant Bed: Stable Turning and Easy Chip Removal
#

The CL Series slant-bed CNC lathes are designed for stable, efficient turning with a bed inclined to improve chip evacuation and rigidity. The range covers models from the 8-inch chuck CL-220 to the 12/15-inch CL-320, with bar capacity from 52 mm to 115 mm.

item.title: Lathes for Industrial Components and Parts | KINWA
item.description:
Components and Parts
#

General industrial components are one of the broadest applications for KINWA lathes. The company lists industrial machinery and components, general metalworking, and component manufacturing among its main application areas.

item.title: Lathes for Energy and Power Transmission Parts | KINWA
item.description:
Energy and Power Transmission
#

KINWA’s company profile lists energy and power transmission components as a suitable application for its lathes. This category includes shafts, couplings, gear blanks, hubs, rings, turbine components and other parts used in power generation, transmission and industrial drive systems.

item.title: KINWA Lathe FAQ: Lathe Basics, Types and Machining
item.description:
Frequently Asked Questions
#

The questions below are based on KINWA’s official lathe knowledge guide. The answers are summarized for quick reading; the full answers are available on the official FAQ page.

item.title: KINWA History and Background: Lathe Manufacturing Since 1968
item.description:
From One Lathe in 1968 to a Global Lathe Brand
#

KINWA’s history is closely tied to the development of Taiwan’s machine tool industry. The company began as a small machining business and grew into a lathe manufacturer with decades of export and OEM experience.

item.title: KINWA International Certifications: TS, TTQS, ISO 9001 and CE
item.description:
Certifications and Quality Recognition
#

KINWA’s public information includes manufacturing safety certification, workforce development certification and references to international quality management and product marking. The scope of each certification depends on the specific machine, configuration and market, so buyers should request the current certificate or declaration for the model being purchased.

item.title: Lathes for Long Shafts and Large Workpieces | KINWA
item.description:
Long Shafts and Large Workpieces
#

Long-shaft and large-workpiece machining is a core part of KINWA’s product positioning. The company’s CHK manual lathes and CL flat-bed CNC lathes are built for workpieces that exceed the capacity of standard lathes.

item.title: Lathes for Maintenance, Repair and Technical Education | KINWA
item.description:
Maintenance, Repair and Technical Education
#

KINWA’s manual lathes are widely used for maintenance, repair and one-off machining, as well as technical education and vocational training. The company lists maintenance and one-off machining, along with technical education and vocational training, among its application areas.

item.title: Lathes for Medical Equipment Components | KINWA
item.description:
Medical Equipment
#

KINWA lists medical equipment as one of its main application areas. Medical devices and equipment often use small or medium-sized turned components with tight tolerances, fine surface finish and consistent quality.

item.title: Lathes for Mold and Die Machining | KINWA
item.description:
Mold and Die Machining
#

KINWA’s company profile lists mold and fixture machining among the applications suitable for its lathes. Mold and die shops use lathes for round mold components, guide pins, ejector pins, cores, inserts, sprue bushings and repair parts.

item.title: Lathes for Oil and Gas Pipeline Components | KINWA
item.description:
Oil and Gas Pipeline Components
#

Oil and gas equipment includes flanges, valve bodies, pipe fittings, connectors, adapters and long shafts that often require large diameters, large spindle bores and long between-centers capacity. KINWA lists oil and gas pipelines as one of the main applications for its lathes.
